## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-sd-sa-soldtopartydetn-set`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Find the communication scenario

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your SAP S/4HANA Cloud tenant. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Communication Management from the home screen. -->
3. <!-- manual: Open the Communication Arrangements app. -->
4. Select **New** to create a new communication arrangement.
5. In the **Scenario** field, search for and select **Sold-to Party Assignment of Sales Scheduling Agreement Integration** (scenario ID: `SAP_COM_0A37` or the matching scenario in your release).

## Step 3: Create a communication system

1. <!-- manual: If you do not already have a Communication System configured for your external application, open the Communication Systems app. -->
2. Select **New** and provide a unique system ID and name.
3. <!-- manual: Select New and provide a unique system ID and name. -->
4. <!-- manual: Set the Host Name to the hostname of your external application or leave it as a placeholder. -->
5. <!-- manual: Under Users for Inbound Communication, add an inbound user or create a new one with a username and password. -->
6. <!-- manual: Save the Communication System. -->

## Step 4: Configure the communication arrangement

1. <!-- manual: Back in the Communication Arrangements app, select the scenario identified in Step 1. -->
2. <!-- manual: Provide a unique Arrangement Name. -->
3. <!-- manual: In the Communication System field, select the Communication System you created or an existing one. -->
4. <!-- manual: Under Inbound Communication, confirm the authentication method is set to User Name and Password. -->
